notes.title: Join the Playtest: Your Feedback Shapes Warden’s Will!
notes.content:
[u][/u][h2]Hello Wardens![/h2]
As you can see, we've been working hard to address all the feedback we've gathered from you. Now, we're inviting you to join our community program and help test the exciting new content we’re planning to add to Warden’s Will!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/521dcf853f77f241e2ad421f98167b6e275b75c1.png[/img]

[u][h3]What's New in This Playtest?[/h3][/u]
You'll get the chance to play and test:
[list]
[*]  New game mode: Necrorift
[*] New boss: Dragonfly
[*] Visual improvements to foliage
[*] Weapon sound rework
[*] Warden abilities sound rework
[*] Improvements to the build stability
[*] Lots of bug fixes
[/list]
[u][h3]How to access the playtest[/h3][/u]
To access the open playtest build and be part of the "Warden Protocol", follow these steps:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/d6be47ec4c09c62a0ca8ea620233007e99a101b3.gif[/img]

Name: [b]beta-testing[/b]
Password: [b]PshJ3ZB3EM0kD8UeW0grG[/b]

[olist]
[*] [b]Right-click on the game[/b] in your Steam library.
[*] Select [b]Properties[/b] from the menu.
[*] Navigate to the [b]Betas[/b] tab.
[*] Paste the provided beta access code into the input box.
[*] Click on [b]Check Code[/b] to validate it.
[*] In the dropdown menu above, select [b][beta-testing][/b].
[*] Steam will start updating the game to the beta version.
[*] To ensure a clean install:
[/olist]
-Once the download is complete,[b] right-click the Steam icon[/b] in the system tray.
-Click [b]Exit Steam[/b] to close the application.
-Relaunch Steam and open the game from within Steam.

[u][h3]How to playtest the new game mode?[/h3][/u]
We now have 2 Game Modes! In addition to our classic Transmitter mode, we’re excited to introduce the first test version of our new game mode, Necrorift. To switch modes, simply open the Pause Menu while in the Lobby and select your preferred game mode. Then, start the game as usual by moving to the portal and voilà! The new game mode will be active. If you're playing in multiplayer, please note that only the host can change the game mode selection.

[u][h3]Known Multiplayer Bug Notice[/h3][/u]
In the new Necrorift mode, a bug may sometimes occur on the client side in multiplayer sessions. Specifically, the Stage Number and Run Timer might disappear for certain clients. Rest assured, this issue does not affect gameplay. We are aware of the bug and are working diligently to resolve it. Thank you for your understanding and patience!


Thank you for your support and feedback. We'll keep working hard to bring you the best from the world of Warden's Will!

notes.title: Introducing the Warden’s Will Roadmap - Post-Release Update #3
notes.content:
Hello Wardens! 
We have been hard at work addressing your feedback and continuing to improve Warden’s Will. Today, we are excited to share a massive update, including recent changes and the unveiling of our Roadmap, which provides a glimpse into the future of the game. 

[u][b]Recent Updates [/b][/u]
Here is what is new and improved in this patch: 

- Levels now unlock upon entry, allowing you to play them in any order during future runs
- Deactivate level hazards by shooting at them
- Augments UI has changed from icons to text for improved clarity
- Crystal buffs are now displayed on the HUD
- D4_Sher is immune to damage during 'Explosive Trailstring (E)' ability
- Bits are now kept after reviving
- Byte Chests are now free and greater in number
- Damage numbers have been scaled to properly display damage buffs
- Damage numbers visuals have been improved
- Sound compression has been enhanced for improved audio quality
- Transmitters now require less data and load faster
- Electrilance continuous heat reduction bug has been fixed
- Overheat Augments have been removed until reworked for a better alternative
- Balancing updates
- Art and shader improvements
- Settings screen fixes

[u][b]THE ROADMAP[/b][/u]
We are excited to reveal our future plans, which are divided into three key steps:

[b]Step One[/b]
Fixing reported bugs and addressing major pain points raised by the community

[b]Step Two[/b]
Introducing highly requested features, including looping runs, new enemies, augment improvements, difficulty settings, and various gameplay improvements

[b]Step Three[/b]
Expanding replayability with new game modes, bosses, enemies, improvements to the augment system, and some other crazy ideas that we will test with our testers
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/06bdfbc5336c008c31ebc2ed02ef87e5caf6d7a1.jpg[/img]

The outlined steps are provisional and may be modified based on various factors, including community feedback.

[b]“Warden Protocol Community Program” - Join the Playtests[/b]

We are also excited to announce our new community program “Warden Protocol” 

This initiative is our way of recognizing and appreciating our amazing community members who actively contribute. By joining, you’ll get an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at our development process. Best of all, it’s completely free! All you need to do is join our Discord, participate in playtests, and share your feedback
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/fcce6277a41b67770caec3f1da1416259615882d.jpg[/img]
Everyone can join the playtests. Here is how you can do it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/d6be47ec4c09c62a0ca8ea620233007e99a101b3.gif[/img]

Name: [b]beta-testing[/b]
Password: [b]PshJ3ZB3EM0kD8UeW0grG[/b]

[olist]
[*] [b]Right-click on the game[/b] in your Steam library.
[*] Select [b]Properties[/b] from the menu.
[*] Navigate to the [b]Betas[/b] tab.
[*] Paste the provided beta access code into the input box.
[*] Click on [b]Check Code[/b] to validate it.
[*] In the dropdown menu above, select [b][beta-testing][/b].
[*] Steam will start updating the game to the beta version.
[*] To ensure a clean install:
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Once the download is complete,[b] right-click the Steam icon[/b] in the system tray.
[*] Click [b]Exit Steam[/b] to close the application.
[*] Relaunch Steam and open the game from within Steam.
[/list]



Thank you for your support and feedback. Together, we will make Warden’s Will better than ever. (edited)

notes.title: Abilities in Boss Fights and Faster Progress - Post-Release Update #1
notes.content:
First, we want to thank each and every one of you for playing Warden’s Will and providing your feedback on launch day. Your enthusiasm and thoughts mean the world to us!

In response to your feedback, we worked tirelessly to address two key areas to enhance your experience, even just hours after release:

[h3][b]Abilities Enabled During Boss Fights[/b][/h3]
Movement and attack abilities are now fully enabled during boss fights! We understand that movement is a core element of Warden’s Will, and we want you to enjoy the fluidity of the gameplay rather than feel restricted. [i](We’ll keep fine-tuning and balancing to ensure the best experience!)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/4a8e7f38406e4f932d0f7db4fe90be9726c18ad2.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Faster Progress for Unlocking Wardens & Weapons[/b][/h3]
Many of you mentioned that the progression for unlocking Wardens and weapons felt a bit too slow. To address this, we reduced unlock costs and increased the rewarded currency. These changes will make it easier and faster for you to unlock and upgrade your favorite Wardens and weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/687522bf12daf22bbbb1d86d0215fc7d1698ac52.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]

We’re working tirelessly to make Warden’s Will the best it can be. Stay tuned for more updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/

notes.content:
[h3]Warden's Will is here! 

[previewyoutube=hqQdBEbhdio;full][/previewyoutube]

Buy or wishlist the game with a launch discount right now: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/


[h2]Release Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]New Augments[/h3]
[list]
[*] A variety of new augments have been fully implemented, featuring unique abilities and triggers to enhance build diversity.
[/list]
[h3]Level Expansions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Levels 4 and 5 are now live, complete with environmental hazards and detailed assets for a richer experience.
[/list]
[h3]Dynamic Difficulty Scaling[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemy and boss difficulty now scales dynamically based on player count and co-op progression, ensuring a balanced challenge.
[/list]
[h3]General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a slow-motion effect after game over for a smoother transition to the stats screen.
[*] Fixed a bug causing crystals to fail to explode properly in multiplayer sessions.
[*] Addressed multiple alignment issues with portals and animations.
[*] Updated key art, splash screens, and game logos on the main menu.
[/list]
[h3]Lobby Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Refined platform designs and polished the overall structure.
[*] Disabled ability cooldowns in the lobby to facilitate uninterrupted pre-game preparation.
[/list]
[h3]Enemy Behavior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhanced AI attack token distribution for more strategic enemy behavior.
[*] Increased difficulty by spawning stronger enemies when median level times are exceeded.
[/list]
[h3]Boss Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced HP for the first two bosses to ease early-game progression.
[*] Added cinematic intro sequences for all boss encounters.
[*] Fixed an issue where the final boss could become invulnerable under certain conditions.
[/list]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*] Railgun’s secondary ability now works consistently in multiplayer.
[*] Plasmaball secondary can now stack up to six and features a larger area of effect.
[*] Reworked Longinus for better balance and usability.
[/list]
[h3]Abilities[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved persistent Trailstring particle effects appearing after player deaths.
[/list]
[h3]Augments[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted Arcbolt and Rocket augment values to reduce overpowered damage.
[*] Rebalanced augment rarities: early-game features fewer high-tier augments, while late-game has increased blue and yellow drops.
[*] Improved augment functionality in multiplayer sessions.
[*] Fixed issues with augments not displaying or functioning correctly after purchase.
[/list]
[h3]Loot and Economy[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the in-game economy for smoother progression.
[*] Installers now become rarer in later stages, while upgraders appear more frequently.
[/list]
[h3]Multiplayer Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed synchronization issues affecting enemy visibility and crystal spawns.
[*] Resolved animation and sound glitches for most abilities in multiplayer.
[*] Ensured HUD elements display consistently after reboots and transitions.
[/list]
[h3]UI/UX Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced new tutorials and improved existing ones.
[*] Added a "Reset Save" button in the options menu with a hold-confirmation dialog.
[*] Updated interactable nameplates for accuracy.
[*] Fixed augment icon display issues in multiplayer.
[*] Improved multiplayer UI button functionality to prevent redundant or invalid actions.
[/list]
[h3]Level Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed transmitter animations and aura alignment for hosts and clients.
[*] Addressed client spawn location issues across multiple levels.
[*] Balanced marker placements for improved visual clarity.
[*] Enhanced lava shaders in Levels 4 and 5 for greater environmental immersion.
[*] Updated crystal explosion effects to align with crystal types and sizes.
[/list]
[h3]Sound Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted sound attenuation and settings across various effects.
[*] Balanced SFX volumes for Leaper’s skills, Cryoflare secondary, and Howitzer pre-fire.
[*] Resolved duplicate SFX issues for dashes and other multiplayer interactions.
[/list]
[h3]Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] Music now syncs properly across clients during gameplay.
[*] Fixed lobby music playback issues for clients in Level 2.
[/list]

notes.title: Warden's Will will be available today!
Warden's Will - Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Wardens! [/h2]

The full release of Warden’s Will is almost here, so we wanted to give you a small sneak peek of what’s going to be arriving on January 8th! The feedback you gave us during the playtests helped with this immensely, and we’re grateful for all your help. Warden’s Will wouldn’t be what it is today without your support! 

But enough talking, let’s get to the changes! Just don’t forget to wishlist the game! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Augments: [/b]We’ve added a lot of new augments to the game to enhance the build variety! Some of them include unique abilities and triggers, making the gameplay much more versatile when you find one.
[*] [b]Level Expansions: [/b]We’ve fully updated levels 4 and 5 of the game with new looks, hazards, and environments. We can’t wait for you to see them in all their glory! 
[*] [b]Dynamic Difficulty Scaling: [/b]We want this game to be fun and challenging no matter the number of players, so we’re introducing dynamic difficulty scaling in the full release, which will account for the number of players in the lobby! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/44ae05479c305818ad7c7ed67f84b314f28ceee9.gif[/img]

[h3]Enemy Behavior:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve improved the enemy AI, so outsmarting the toughest of them can be a bit tougher! We’ve also updated the enemy spawning system, so tougher enemies are more likely to spawn, the more time you spend on the level. Prepare for a challenge! 
[*] We’ve reworked some of the bosses based on your feedback. For example, we’ve toned down the health pools of the starting bosses to positively impact the early-game progression, and we’ve also updated the Final boss fight to exclude the invincibility windows it previously had, which were a point of frustration for some of our players during the playtests! 
[*] And, of course, there’s more flare - we’ve added cinematic intro sequences for all boss fights, and they’re EPIC.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/8a395ca611ff974ff916dbf02a3dcd7a3fbbaf9f.gif[/img]

[h3]Loot and Economy:[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve rebalanced the overall economy and loot spawn logic since some of you noted that during the playtests it was sometimes preferable to stay on the first stage instead of progressing to the next levels. So now you can expect much better loot as you progress through the levels, and you won’t need to farm everything in one place! 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/daa25c19d649137145eeec502967f969a1767bab.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]

These are just some of the things that will be included in the full release of Warden’s Will but we wanted to highlight them to you, Wardens, so you know what to expect from the game and know that your feedback was heard and implemented! 

[h2]Only a day left until January 8, and we can’t wait for you to try the finished game! 

Don’t forget to wishlist:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1689640/Wardens_Will/

[h2]And Join our Discord:[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/C3dkeMPJyu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41285644/b282e21382cdd97f196a9206858efca5c81e6432.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:
Hello Wardens!

We've just put out an update for the Warden's Will Demo for Next Fest! Here is a video below explaining what we have changed in short, or you can read the whole thing below. Go now and destroy some evil robots!

[previewyoutube=J46CsPgHn2M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Heroes[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Faster ground movement
[*] Fixed consistency of reactors trails
[*] Added low health indicator
[*] Added visual effects to better represents effective bonuses and augments
[*] Changed Damage Taken SFX
[/list]
[h3]Dasher[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complete rework of the hero movement
[*] Faster and shorter dashes
[*] Dashes are now directional
[*] Energy regen is much faster
[*] Trailstring is faster and has 4 dashes
[*] Bladestorm can now be chained/re-triggered if not all 10 attacks are used
[/list]
[h3]Hover[/h3]
[list]
[*] Closer camera when hovering to emphasize shooting
[*] Lower energy consumption
[*] Ion Cannon damage is higher and duration is shorter
[*] Orbital Strike triggers faster
[*] Orbital Strike camera zooms out while targeting
[/list]
[h3]Flyer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now gains speed going downwards while losing speed going upwards
[*] This results in longer range with proper use
[*] Faster energy regen
[*] Camera tweaks
[/list]

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
[list]
[*] New weapon : Cryoflare ! Is it cold ? Is it hot ? Who knows !
[*] Minor sound effect changes - Some are still placeholders
[/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]    
[list]
[*] Improved performances in some specific areas of the level 1
[*] Improved visual feedback whenever an enemy spawns
[*] Fixed attack animation of the Howitzer
[*] Added visual cues when a Driller attacks
[*] SFX improvements for attack telegraphs
[/list]
[h3]Breaches[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed visuals of the enemy breaches
[/list]
[h2]Level Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Necrogod influence has spread following failed wardens attempt to save Sentient installation.
[*] Fixed multiple collision issues
[/list]

[h2]Interactables
[/h2]

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added white outline whenever player can use the interaction key with an interactable
[*] Collecting Bits and Data is now “a bit” easier
[*] Improved visibility of price display when approaching Augments dispensers
[/list]
[h3]Transmitter[/h3]
[list]
[*] Revamped all visuals
[*] When fully uploaded, a transmitter now hint locations leading toward other transmitters
[*] Exposed the list of transmitters to find under the objective tracker in the user interface
[/list]
[h3]Crystals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an effect to better represent the area of effect triggered upon crystal destruction
[*] Red crystal now grants a temporary damage boost
[/list]

[h2]Accessibility[/h2]

[list]
[*] Removed tutorial level section
[*] Fixed stutter and/or flickering that could appear when launching the game
[*] Added more contextual tutorial hints when playing
[*] Added hints during loading screens
[*] Better gamepad support overall
[*] You can now tweak 3 different and cumulative aim assist settings from Options menu
[*] Aim Assist can be set for mouse-keyboard and gamepad separately
[*] Graphic settings now fully works as intended - except Shading Quality that has no effect at the moment
[*] Audio settings now fully works as intended
[*] Added missing icons for mouse-keyboard in case of remapping
[*] Remapping a key when playing will now properly be updated on the user interface without requiring the game to be relaunched
[/list]
